question: Which grants are open with a deadline in January 2027?
answer:
There are four research grants currently open with deadlines in January 2027. Applications must be submitted before the specified deadline [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2].

The following grants are available:

| Grant Code | Title | Application Deadline |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| GR-ML-02 | Undergraduate Machine Learning Research Assistantship | 10 Jan 2027 [SQL] |
| GR-IOT-07 | Smart Campus IoT Research Grant | 20 Jan 2027 [SQL] |
| GR-CY-03 | Cybersecurity Research Scholarship | 31 Jan 2027 [SQL] |
| GR-5G-15 | 5G and Next-Gen Networks Fellowship | 31 Jan 2027 [SQL] |

Please note that applications are only accepted while the grant's status in the Register is open [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2]. Eligibility is assessed based on your CGPA, and first-year students are not eligible for any grants as they do not yet have a CGPA [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2].
sql: SELECT grant_code, title, application_deadline FROM grants WHERE status = 'open' AND application_deadline >= '2027-01-01' AND application_deadline <= '2027-01-31' ORDER BY application_deadline LIMIT 200
